name: Nelson County, KY
findings: Nelson County has 114 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Nelson County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Nelson County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 62% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 42 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
